notes.title: Version 2.03 released several days ago
notes.content:
Changes in v2.03:
- A few books in the library in Afthonia had somehow lost their titles. New titles have now been delivered, fresh from Oneiropolis University.
- A bit of missing punctuation has been discovered under a mushroom and put back where it belongs.
- All of this actually happened several days before this announcement, but it was a busy week that contained birthdays and other mysterious rituals, so someone forgot to post this message.

notes.title: Version 2.01 released
notes.content:
Changes in this version:

- There are now some options for using the portal in fullscreen or windowed mode. You can also use Alt + Enter to switch, as before.
- Torcan has remembered what he wanted to say about Hashim.
- Omar no longer confuses the dialogue menu with multiple identical topics.
- The desert gate in Sadaqah has stopped sometimes losing its description. (We attached it with gaffer tape.)
- A strange creature in another dimension now knows the difference between east and west.
- Saving and loading has changed to prevent a bug involving saving earlier states over more advanced ones. We are hoping this change, which involves deleting old files and replacing them with new ones, will not cause new bugs.
- The save/load system now keeps backups.
- The portal now requires administrator privileges to run, to make sure it can actually save and load.
